description: Does the fixed meat/seafood-food parent miss other ordinary members, or mainly Steak in this small diagnostic?
approval: User approved checking other obvious members and clear nonmembers while keeping TRUE and cutoff fixed. Both directions retained as in prior probes.

cases.title: Plain boiled rice
cases.reason: Plain boiled rice does not require meat or seafood; serving it alongside meat does not make its category a refinement.

cases.title: Fresh fruit
cases.reason: Fresh fruit does not require meat or seafood.

cases.title: Vegan meals
cases.reason: Vegan meals exclude meat and seafood.
cases.role: Related food category with an explicit exclusion.

control: P01 repeats the exact existing Steak relation. All cases share the exact parent, input format, model and decision rules; only the proposed child changes.

selection.limits: Selected everyday-food diagnostic, not a random sample, unseen-holdout claim, new corpus segmentation, or population accuracy estimate. The repeated baseline is not a new independent relationship.

hypothesis: The fixed category description will accept several other clear meat/seafood members while rejecting clear nonmembers. Record all outcomes, including if several members fail.
interpretation: If other members pass, the Steak miss does not demonstrate wholesale failure for this parent. If additional members fail, the miss is not Steak-specific. Neither outcome alone isolates a causal mechanism such as wording, domain familiarity, template interpretation or NLI training.
reporting: Report every child, expected answer, native answer, fixed-cutoff answer and exact score, plus all reverse checks. Do not retune the cutoff or choose a favourable subset after scores.
next_decision: Use the distribution of successes and misses to propose one focused diagnostic or alternative judge comparison. No further run or production change is authorized.

unchanged.model_input: premise: This text is about {B}. hypothesis: This text is about {A}.
unchanged.model_evidence: Only category title text; no masks, judgments, rationales, semantic reviewer or prior scores.
unchanged.inference: Unchanged run_inference: CPU float32, batch4, four threads, seed0, greedy1beam, max3 generated tokens, EOS required, no input truncation.
unchanged.cutoff: entailment_score > 0.142 using full-vocabulary first output token 209 probability; native answer reported separately.

resources: One cached offline model. At least70GiB available before launch; MemoryMax60G, MemorySwapMax0, CPUQuota400%. No new rental, download, API inference or training.
compatibility: TRUE03 fixture tag is existing validator schema only. Runtime TRUE08; domain metadata manual-member-probe. Shared raw DECISIONS may say holdout, but this is a selected diagnostic.
